name: Mattathias
title: Ancestor of Jesus in Luke's genealogy
summary: Mattathias is a person mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus in the Gospel of Luke. He is the son of Levi and the father of Eli (or Heli), and is part of the lineage that traces Jesus back to David and further to Adam. Very little is known about him beyond his place in the family tree.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Jesus' genealogy
keyEvents.description: Mattathias is listed as one of Jesus' ancestors in Luke's genealogy, as the son of Levi and father of Eli.

keyEvents.title: Part of the lineage from David to Jesus
keyEvents.description: Mattathias is part of the long lineage connecting King David with Jesus through Nathan's line, as presented by Luke.

keyEvents.title: Placed in the intertestamental period
keyEvents.description: Mattath's placement in the genealogy suggests he lived during the period between the Old and New Testaments, a time when God's people were waiting for the Messiah.

keyEvents.title: Testimony to God's faithfulness through generations
keyEvents.description: Through the genealogies, Luke shows that God faithfully fulfilled his promise of a Messiah through ordinary people like Mattath, generation after generation.
